summary.headline: Conjunctions and Hoped-for Matters
summary.text: Astrological doctrine of conjunction: opposition, trine, quartile, sextile, and conjunction are aspects formed in houses, with applying and separating planets indicating future and past events. Chapter II introduces judging whether a hoped-for matter, rumor, or undertaking will occur from the moment the question is asked.
